teaser: A lantern gutters low at the edge of a campsite, and you're the one who swaps the batteries before anyone else noticed the dark coming on. Life path 7 asks for solitude and long private questions; ESFP moves through the world by touch, by crowd, by whatever bright thing is happening now. Crossed, the two don't cancel each other out — a hunger for truth sits inside someone who finds it by living loud, not by shutting a door and thinking it through alone. You take in people the way the 7 takes in a mystery: fast, and from the outside in.
